VERDICT: LGTM

The new `formatMembershipTier` slots in exactly alongside the existing `@Named` derivation helpers (`formatMembershipNumber`, `formatDisplayName`, `formatInitials`), wired the same way via a `@Mapping(..., qualifiedByName = ...)` on `toOwnerDto`. The null-guard style, Javadoc format, placement near the other membership helper, and the `openapi.yml` read-only enum field all match the surrounding conventions. Logic lives in the right unit (the mapper, next to its peers), nothing is duplicated, and the interface isn't becoming a catch-all. A maintainer of this codebase would find it natural.
